input.free_text_description: The system operates in the authentication, e-commerce domain. It serves Customer, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include user, token, token impl. Core business data revolves around Result, User. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a Customer, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a Customer, I want to interact with token functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
As a Customer, I want to interact with token impl functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
As a Customer, I want to interact with user impl functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
